# Sweepr Customer App

> app.getsweepr.com is Sweepr's customer booking app. Almost all of it
> requires a signed-in account; the public surface is limited to sign-in and
> sign-up. For an overview of Sweepr and how booking works, see the
> marketing site.

## Key pages

- [Sign up](https://app.getsweepr.com/sign-up): Create a Sweepr customer account.
- [Sign in](https://app.getsweepr.com/sign-in): Sign in to an existing account.
- [Sweepr marketing site](https://getsweepr.com/): Book a cleaning, see pricing and FAQ.
- [Sweepr for Business](https://business.getsweepr.com/): Manage cleanings across multiple properties.
